name: cc-plugins
description: A curated collection of plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: ccbell
plugins.description: Audio notifications for Claude Code events - play sounds when Claude finishes responding, needs permission, is waiting for input, or when a subagent completes

plugins.name: flowpane
plugins.description: A live workflow pane - replaces the default Workflow progress list with a phase-by-phase graph or a timeline beside the transcript, showing each agent's state, timing, live token spend, tool calls and prompt
